# SM Solar & Electrical (San Marina Engineering Limited)
# https://www.sanmarina.engineering

> SM Solar & Electrical is the renewable energy and electrical solutions business of San Marina Engineering Limited. Based in Kisumu, Kenya, we design, deliver and support solar PV, battery energy storage, critical power, electrical infrastructure, solar water pumping, safety & compliance, consultancy and maintenance for homes, businesses and institutions in Nairobi, Kisumu and towns across Kenya.

## Also known as
SM Solar, SM Solar Ltd, SM Solar Engineering, SM Engineering, San Marina Engineering, San Marina Solar.
